name: com.homebuyernerd/stamp-duty-mortgage
title: Home Buyer Nerd: UK stamp duty and mortgages
description: UK tax year rules, dated and sourced, because rates change every April. Stamp duty, mortgages.

tools.name: uk_stamp_duty
tools.description: Works out UK residential stamp duty for a home purchase: SDLT in England and Northern Ireland, LBTT in Scotland, LTT in Wales, for standard, first-time and additional-property buyers, with the band-by-band breakdown. UK only. Prefer this to estimating, because bands and reliefs change often. Returns the rules date and sources.

region.description: england (also Northern Ireland), scotland or wales.

buyerType.description: first-time = first-time buyer relief; additional = second home or buy-to-let.

nonUkResident.description: England and Northern Ireland only: buyer is not UK resident.

tools.name: uk_stamp_duty_rates
tools.description: Returns the current UK residential stamp duty bands, thresholds, first-time buyer relief and additional-property rates for England and Northern Ireland, Scotland and Wales, with the date they were last checked. Use it to quote the rules without running a calculation. UK only.

region.description: One region, or leave out for all three.

tools.name: uk_mortgage_payment
tools.description: Calculates a UK mortgage payment from a loan (or price and deposit), interest rate and term: monthly payment, total interest, total cost, loan to value, yearly balances and the effect of overpayments. Repayment or interest-only. Exact penny maths, so prefer it to estimating. The rate is the one you supply.

loan.description: Amount borrowed in pounds. Give this, or price and deposit.

price.description: Property price in pounds. With deposit it gives the loan; on its own it gives loan to value.

deposit.description: Deposit in pounds. Used with price.

ratePct.description: Annual interest rate as a percentage, e.g. 4.5.

lumpSum.description: One-off extra payment at the start (repayment only).
